cause: Interval issue repeats complete authority resolution/validity before and after a structurally authorized read-only proof. In the finance fixture, the validity callback reruns the complete sensitivity resolver. The proposal removes only the redundant eager full callback on the successful path.
proposed_change: Detach and hash the initial authority as before; retain the initial mutable-object digest check.
Keep all remaining eligibility, classification, source, rule, structural proof, certificate, issued-map insertion, final current() and failure cleanup inside a local prepare() boundary.
Successful prepare still executes original final current(): fresh authority read, validity predicate, authority and certificate equality, context scope and existing TTL handling.

Every non-ok prepare result checks the ORIGINAL authority predicate and original mutable-object digest before returning. Invalid authority returns stale, preventing unavailable from entering the caller's conditioned fallback.
After every prepare result also check the original mutable-object digest. If an ok interval must be rejected, delete its provisional issued-map entry.
Do not catch exceptions into success or unavailable; do not cache authority across operations.
